QKVM does not take pull requests: it is written and maintained by its publisher alone (see
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/qkvm/qkvm/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for why).

Please open an issue instead and describe what you found, or the fix you have in mind:
https://github.com/qkvm/qkvm/issues. A security problem goes through the *Security* tab,
privately.
